_comment: Per-skill dependency manifest read by scripts/preflight.sh (engine vendored across the family). Base checks — git work tree, gh installed+authenticated, jq — are always run by the engine.
notes: Validation of a candidate fix MAY use the SonarQube MCP (analyze_code_snippet); only the harness can check MCP availability. Harvest, the ledger, grading, and landing all work without it.

The Harvest step MAY invoke the external /reflect skill for a structured conversation pass (see SKILL.md step 2a); it is optional — if /reflect is not installed, improve falls back to reflecting over the transcript itself. Not a hard dependency.
